parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of results per page. Default to 20

parameters.name: datacenters
parameters.description: Filter on datacenters where the server is available. Repeat the parameter for multiple values

parameters.name: mergeGenerations
parameters.description: Fold the hardware generations of a model into one server, the newest one extended with the datacenters only older generations still serve. Default to true; false lists every generation

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset of the first result returned, used with count for pagination

parameters.name: osAvailable
parameters.description: Filter on available operating systems. Repeat the parameter for multiple values

parameters.name: planCodes
parameters.description: Return only the servers with these plan codes, comma-separated (e.g. 25rise01,25adv01), matched case-insensitively

parameters.name: priceMax
parameters.description: Maximum monthly price, in the subsidiary currency (e.g. 499.99)

parameters.name: priceMin
parameters.description: Minimum monthly price, in the subsidiary currency (e.g. 99.99)

parameters.name: ranges
parameters.description: Filter on commercial ranges. Repeat the parameter for multiple values

parameters.name: sockets
parameters.description: Filter on the number of CPU sockets. Repeat the parameter for multiple values

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: price-asc (default), price-desc, name-asc or name-desc. Servers with a promotion always come first

parameters.name: storageRaid
parameters.description: Filter on RAID levels of the default storage configuration. Repeat the parameter for multiple values

parameters.name: storageTypes
parameters.description: Filter on storage types. Repeat the parameter for multiple values

parameters.name: useCases
parameters.description: Filter on server use cases. Repeat the parameter for multiple values

parameters.name: withGpu
